verdict.rationale: Jira ships a well-known REST API and JQL query language, confirmed by hands-on developer usage (writing wrapper scripts, executing REST queries, appreciating JQL) rather than just marketing claims, and Atlassian also documents an official MCP server. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt at the probed canonical paths (both 404'd), and no first-party docs excerpt in this pack detailing endpoint structure/authentication.
